A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
metaphor is the most important tool for language users to express their feelings and emotions, and it is also the most important way for people to communicate.
metaphor is a kind of transference,which can be realized at lexical,syntactical and text levels and the function of metaphor is to make language vivid and expressive.
metaphor is not merely a lexical device, but a rhetorical, syntactic, and textual device, and it is the latter that makes it a powerful tool for the construction of meaning in a text.
